question:
The median date of the year 2019, given in the form of DD.MM is:
(MTS 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 02.07.

Total days in 2019 = 365
Median days = \(\left(\frac{365+1}{2}\right)^{th}\) days = 183 th days
1 Jan to 30 June = 181 days
\(\therefore\) Median date = 2 July = 02.07
question_hi:
वर्ष 2019 की माध्यिका तिथि, DD.MM के रूप में दी गई है:
(MTS 2019 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 02.07 है। 

2019 में कुल दिन = 365
औसत दिन =\( \left(\frac{365+1}{2}\right)^{th} \)दिन = 183वा दिन
1 जनवरी से 30 जून = 181 दिन
\(\therefore\) औसत दिन = 2 जुलाई = 02.07

question:
What is the difference between the mean and median of the given data?
4, 13, 8, 15, 9, 21, 18, 23, 35, 1?
(MTS 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 0.7.

Arrange the data in ascending order = 1, 4, 8, 9, 13, 15, 18, 21, 23, 35
Sum of these data = 147
\(\therefore\) mean = \(\frac{147}{10}\) = 14.7
Median = \(\frac{5^{th}+6^{th}}{2}\)= \(\frac{13+15}{2}\) = 14 
\(\therefore\) Required difference = 14.7 - 14 = 0.7

आंकड़ों को आरोही क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें = 1, 4, 8, 9, 13, 15, 18, 21, 23, 35
इन आंकड़ों का योग = 147
\(\therefore\) माध्य = \(\frac{147}{10}\) =14.7
माध्यिका = \(\frac{5^{th}+6^{th}}{2}\)= \(\frac{13+15}{2}\) = 14

question:
Let x be the median of the data: 33, 42, 28, 49, 32, 37, 52, 57, 35, 41. If 32 is replaced by 36 and 41 by 63, then the median of the data, so obtained, is y. What is the value of (x + y)?
(MTS 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 78.5.

Arrange the data in ascending order = 28, 32, 33, 35, 37, 41, 42, 49, 52, 57
n = 10 (even)
\(\therefore\) Median = \(\frac{\left(\frac{n}{2}\right)^{th}+\left(\frac{n}{2}+1\right)^{th}}{2}\) 
⇒ \( \frac{\left(\frac{10}{2}\right)^{th}+\left(\frac{10}{2}+1\right)^{th}}{2}\)
⇒ \(\frac{5^{th}+6^{th}}{2}\) = \(\frac{37+41}{2}\) = 39 = x
Replace 32 by 36 and 41 by 63, and arrange the data in ascending order
28, 33, 35, 36, 37, 42, 49, 52, 57, 63
\(\therefore\) Median = \(\frac{5^{th}+6^{th}}{2}\) = \(\frac{37+42}{2}\) = 39.5 = y
⇒ x + y = 39 + 39.5 = 78.5
question_hi:
मान लीजिए x, आँकड़ों की माध्यिका है: 33, 42, 28, 49, 32, 37, 52, 57, 35, 41। यदि 32 को 36 से और 41 को 63 से प्रतिस्थापित किया जाए, तो प्राप्त आँकड़ों की माध्यिका y है। (x + y) का मान क्या है?
(MTS 2019 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् 78.5 है।

आंकड़ों को आरोही क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें = 28, 32, 33, 35, 37, 41, 42, 49, 52, 57
n = 10 (सम)
\(\therefore\) माध्यिका = \(\frac{\left(\frac{n}{2}\right)^{th}+\left(\frac{n}{2}+1\right)^{th}}{2}\)
⇒ \( \frac{\left(\frac{10}{2}\right)^{th}+\left(\frac{10}{2}+1\right)^{th}}{2}\)
⇒ \(\frac{5^{th}+6^{th}}{2}\) = \(\frac{37+41}{2}\) = 39 = x
32 को 36 से तथा 41 को 63 से प्रतिस्थापित करें तथा डेटा को आरोही क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें
28, 33, 35, 36, 37, 42, 49, 52, 57, 63
\(\therefore\) माध्यिका = \(\frac{5^{th}+6^{th}}{2}\)= \(\frac{37+42}{2}\) = 39.5 = y
⇒ x + y = 39 + 39.5 = 78.5

question:
If the median of the following data is 11, then find the value of k.
3, 21, 10, 7, 6, 9, (k + 6), 15, 20, 16
(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 6.

Firstly, arrange the series in ascending order
3, 6, 7, 9, (k + 6), 10, 15, 16, 20, 21
Median = 11
Total number of terms = 10 
Median = (5th Term + 6th Term)/2
⇒ 11 = \([(k+6)+10]\over2\)
⇒ 22 = k + 16
⇒ k = 6
question_hi:
यदि निम्न आंकड़ों की माध्यिका 11 है, तो k का मान ज्ञात करें।
3, 21, 10, 7, 6, 9, (k + 6), 15, 20, 16
(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 6 है।

सबसे पहले, श्रृंखला को आरोही क्रम में व्यवस्थित करें
3, 6, 7, 9, (k + 6), 10, 15, 16, 20, 21
माध्यिका = 11
कुल पदों की संख्या = 10
माध्यिका = (5वाँ पद + 6वाँ पद)/2
⇒ 11 = \([(k+6)+10]\over2\)
⇒ 22 = k + 16
⇒ k = 6

(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:

Mean = \(\frac{11+10+12+13+15+x+17}{7}\)

⇒ 15 = \(78+x\over7\)

⇒ 105 = 78 + x

⇒ x = 27

(MTS 2020 Pre)

⇒ 15 = \(78+x\over7\)

⇒ 105 = 78 + x

question:
If the mode of the following data is 14, then what is the value of k?

(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 15.

Arrange the data in ascending order: 
8, 9, 11, 11, 12, 12, 14, 15, (k - 1), (k - 1), k
Mode = 14 (most repeated)
to become a mode of 14, (k - 1) should be equal to 14.
⇒ (k - 1) = 14
⇒ k = 15

solution_hi:

⇒ (k - 1) = 14
⇒ k = 15

question:
The mean of a set of 120 observations is 80. 10 is subtracted from each observation, and each of the corresponding results is divided by 7. What is the mean of the new set?
(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e. 10.

Total of 120 observations = 120 × 80 = 9600
After decreasing new total = 9600 - 10 × 120 = 8400
After dividing each term by 7
New total = \(\frac{8400}{7}\) = 1200
New mean = \(\frac{1200}{120}\) = 10
question_hi:
120 प्रेक्षणों के समुच्चय का मध्य 80 है। प्रत्येक प्रेक्षण में से 10 घटाया जाता है और इससे प्राप्त मान को 7 से विभाजित किया जाता हैं नये समुच्चय का माध्य ज्ञात कीजिये?
(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात् 10 है।

कुल 120 प्रेक्षण = 120 × 80 = 9600
नए योग में कमी के बाद = 9600 - 10 × 120 = 8400
प्रत्येक पद को 7 से विभाजित करने के बाद
नया योग = \(\frac{8400}{7}\) =1200
नया माध्य = \(\frac{1200}{120}\) =10

question: The numbers 8, 9, 11, 15, 17, 21, and N are arranged in ascending order. The mean of these numbers is equal to the median of the numbers. The value of N is:
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 24.

Median of the numbers = \((n + 1)\over2\) = 4th term = 15
⇒ \((8 + 9 + 11 + 15 + 17 + 21 + N)\over7\) = 15
⇒ \(81 + N\over7\) = 15

⇒ 81 + N = 105
⇒ N = 24
question_hi: संख्याओं 8, 9, 11, 15, 17, 21 और N को आरोही क्रम में व्यवस्थित किया जाता है। इन संख्याओं का माध्य, संख्याओं की माध्यिका के बराबर है। N का मान ज्ञात करें।
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् 24 है।

संख्याओं का माध्यिका = \((n + 1)\over2\) = चौथा पद = 15
⇒ \((8 + 9 + 11 + 15 + 17 + 21 + N)\over7\) = 15
⇒ \(81 + N\over7\) = 15

⇒ 81 + N = 105
⇒ N = 24

question:
If the difference between the mode and median of a data set is 38, then the difference between the median and mean is:
(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1 i.e. 19.

Mode = 3 median – 2 mean
⇒ Mode – Median = 38
⇒ 3 Median – Mode = 2 mean
⇒ 2 Median + (Median – Mode) = 2 Mean
⇒ 2 Median – 38 = 2 Mean
⇒ Median – Mean = 19
question_hi:
यदि किसी डेटा सेट के बहुलक और माध्यिका के बीच का अंतर 38 है, तो माध्यिका और माध्य के बीच का अंतर है:
(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 अर्थात् 19 है।

बहुलक = 3 माध्यिका – 2 माध्य
⇒ बहुलक – माध्यिका = 38
⇒ 3 माध्यिका – बहुलक = 2 माध्य
⇒ 2 माध्यिका + (माध्यिका – बहुलक) = 2 माध्य
⇒ 2 माध्यिका – 38 = 2 माध्य
⇒ माध्यिका – माध्य = 19

question:
If a, b, and c are the median, mode, and range, respectively, of the data: 8, 5, 4, 3, 2, 7, 3, 10, 9, 17, 12, 3, 8, 4, then what is the value of (3a - 2b + c)?
(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 27.

Arrange the data in ascending order: 2, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 7, 8, 8, 9, 10, 12, 17
n = 14 (even)
a = median =  \(\frac{\frac{n^{th}}{2}term+\left(\frac{n}{2}+1\right)^{th}term}{2}\) = \( \frac{5+7}{2}\) = 6
b = mode = 3(Max. Repetition)
c = range = 17 - 2 = 15
\(\therefore\) (3a – 2b + c) = (3 × 6 – 2 × 3 + 15)
⇒ (18 – 6 + 15) = 27

n = 14 (सम)
a = माध्यिका =  \(\frac{\frac{n^{th}}{2}term+\left(\frac{n}{2}+1\right)^{th}term}{2}\) = \( \frac{5+7}{2}\) = 6
b = बहुलक = 3(अधिकतम दोहराव)
c = परास = 17 - 2 = 15
\(\therefore\) (3a – 2b + c) = (3 × 6 – 2 × 3 + 15)

question:
The numbers 25, 34, 46, 48, 2x + 1, 4x + 3, 105, 110, 114, 122 are written in ascending order, and their median is 77. The value of x is:
(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 25.

Number of terms = 10
Median = \(\frac{5^{th}+6^{th}}{2}=\frac{2x+1+4x+3}{2} \) 
⇒ 77 = \(6x+4\over2\)
⇒ 77 = 3x + 2
⇒ 75 = 3x
⇒ x = 25
question_hi:

solution_hi:

पदों की संख्या = 10
माध्यिका = \(\frac{5^{th}+6^{th}}{2}=\frac{2x+1+4x+3}{2} \) 
⇒ 77 = \(6x+4\over2\)
⇒ 77 = 3x + 2
⇒ 75 = 3x
⇒ x = 25

question:
Two clocks were synchronised at 11 a.m. on a Sunday. Thereafter, every day, they were respectively found to gain and lose one minute per day. What time, expressed in hours and minutes, will the second clock show when the first clock shows 10 p.m. on the next Friday?
(MTS 2020 Pre)
options:
9 hours \(48\frac{3}{11}\) minutes p.m.

9 hours \(48\frac{7}{11}\) minutes p.m.

9 hours \(49\frac{1}{11}\) minutes p.m

9 hours \(49\frac{9}{11} \) minutes p.m.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 9 hours \(49\frac{1}{11}\) minutes p.m.

Slow clock           Time                  Fast clock
23 hr 59 min.      24hr                   24 hr 1m
1439min.          1440min.            1441min

                                                     Next Friday
at 10 pm = 5 days + 11 hrs = 131 h
⇒ 1441 unit = 1439
⇒ 1 unit = \(\frac{1439}{1441}\)
⇒ 131 unit = \(\frac{1439}{1441}\times131\)
⇒ \(\frac{1439}{11}\) = \(130\frac{9}{11}\)
⇒ 120 + 10 hr + \(\frac{9\times60}{11}\)
⇒ 5 days + 10 hr + \(49\frac{1}{11}\)
⇒ Friday = 9 pm \(49\frac{1}{11}\) min

question:
If the ratio of the mode and median of a certain data is 9 : 8, then the ratio of its mean and median is:
(MTS 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. 15 : 16.

Median  :  Mode
      8       :     9
⇒ 3 median = mode + 2 mean
⇒ 3(8) = 9 + 2 mean
⇒ Mean = \(\frac{15}{2}\)
⇒ \(\frac{mean}{median}=\frac{15}{2\left(8\right)}=\frac{15}{16}  \)

(MTS 2020 Pre)

सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात् 15 : 16 है।

माध्यिका  :  बहुलक
      8       :     9
⇒ 3 माध्यिका = बहुलक + 2 माध्य
⇒ 3(8) = 9 + 2 माध्य
⇒ माध्य = \(\frac{15}{2}\)
⇒ माध्य/माध्यिका = \(\frac{15}{2(8)} =\frac{15}{16}\)

माध्यिका 7वें और 8वें पद का औसत होगी = \(\frac{16+17}{2}\) = \(33\over2\) = 16.5
बहुलक वह पद होगा जिसकी आवृत्ति अधिकतम होगी, जो 19 है
माध्यिका और बहुलक का माध्य = \(\frac{16.5+19}{2}\) = 17.75
